#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    vector<int> parentStart;
    vector<int> parentEnd;

    int n;
    string target;
    cin >> n;
    cin >> target;

    for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if(target[i] == '(')
            parentStart.push_back(i);
        if(target[i] == ')')
            parentEnd.push_back(i);
    }

    int count = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < (int)parentEnd.size(); i++) {
        string s = target.substr(parentStart[i] + 1, parentEnd[i] - parentStart[i] - 1);
        stringstream ss(s);
        string token;
        while(getline(ss, token, '_')) {
            if(!token.empty()) count++;
        }
    }

    int Max = 0;
    parentEnd.insert(parentEnd.begin(), 0);
    parentStart.push_back(target.length());

    int i;
    if(target[0] == '(')
        i = 1;
    else
        i = 0;

    for(; i < (int)parentEnd.size(); i++) {
        string s;
        if(target[parentEnd[i]] == ')')
            s = target.substr(parentEnd[i] + 1, parentStart[i] - parentEnd[i] - 1);
        else
            s = target.substr(parentEnd[i], parentStart[i] - parentEnd[i]);
        stringstream ss(s);
        string token;
        while(getline(ss, token, '_')) {
            if((int)token.length() > Max && token.find('(') == string::npos && token.find(')') == string::npos) {
                Max = token.length();
            }
        }
    }

    cout << Max << " " << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
